科研.title: Community detection in complex networks via node similarity, graph representation learning, and hierarchical clustering
科研.summary: arXiv:2303.12212v3 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: Community detection is a significant challenge in analysing real graphs, including social, citation, biological, and many other networks. This article proposes three new, general, hierarchical frameworks to deal with this task. The introduced approach supports various linkage-based clustering algorithms, vertex proximity matrices, and graph representation learning models. We compare 364 module combinations on Stochastic Block Model graphs and real-life datasets. We observe that our best pipelines (Wasserman-Faust and the mutual information-based PPMI proximity, as well as the deep learning-based DNGR representations) perform competitively with the state-of-the-art Leiden and Louvain algorithms. At the same time, unlike the latter, they remain hierarchical. Thus, they output a series of nested partitions of all possible cardinalities which are compatible with each other. This feature is crucial when the number of correct partitions is unknown in advance, and we show that it is obtained at near-zero practical cost in terms of partition quality. On graphs composed of many small communities, our pipelines are more accurate than the reference solutions. Nevertheless, the downside of our approach is its time complexity, which confines the framework to networks of some 10000 vertices on personal machines.

Known as quark-gluon plasma, this exotic substance forms at temperatures more than 100,000 times hotter than the center of the Sun, causing ordinary particles to break apart into their fundamental building blocks.

科技.title: 尼康 ZR 全画幅相机 2.00 版本固件发布：H.265 视频格式支持 RED 色彩科学，即将开放下载
科技.summary: IT之家 11 月 4 日消息，9 月 8 日，尼康公布了尼康 ZR 全画幅相机 2.00 版本固件的开发消息。今日，尼康正式宣布推出适用于尼康 ZR 的固件 2.00 版本，将于稍晚时日开放下载。 尼康表示，固件 2.00 版本是 ZR 上市以来的首次重大更新，旨在进一步拓展创作表现力并优化影像制作工作流。IT之家附主要功能特点如下： 融 RED 色彩科学于更紧凑的 H.265 视频录制格式 以 H.265 格式录制时，色调模式选项中新增 Log3G10 曲线，支持在 REDWideGamutRGB 色彩空间下拍摄。由此， 即使采用文件体积较小的 H.265 格式录制，也能凭借 RED 色彩科学的平滑色调过渡与宽广色域 ，获得较高的调色宽容度。此外，以 H.265 格式进行 Log3G10 或 N-Log 录制时，可从 4 档设定中选择 [高 ISO 降噪] 的程度。 ▲ Log3G10 曲线 ▲ 色彩空间示意图（浅蓝色表示 RWG，即 RedWideGamutRGB） 提升操控性能 可将 ISO 感光度、曝光设置、白平衡（WB）及白平衡色温（WBK）分配给指令拨盘，支持用户自定义相机操作，提升便捷性。此外，还可将 [3D LUT / 色彩 显 示 辅 助 ] 指定给 Fn 按钮，单次操作即可切换相关设置。操作者无需将视线移开显示屏，即可调整设置。 其他功能 特点 以 R3D NE 格式录制时，即使应用 3D LUT，也支持显示对焦峰值，便于更精确地确认对焦。 支持将 3D LUT 应用于 HDMI 视频输出，即使连接外接监视器，也能预览接近成片效果的画面。 新增可抑制黑电平波动的处理功能，减少较低光环境及画面暗部容易出现的闪烁。
